title: Image Tracking AR POC
subtitle: Unity AR prototype for QR/image tracking with runtime prefab placement
challenge: Built a Unity AR image tracking proof-of-concept that detects reference images and spawns tracked prefabs in mobile runtime while keeping the app portable to Android and iOS.
architecture: Event-driven AR tracking with prefab pooling and camera-facing world-space UI for tracked targets.
codeSnippet: private void UpdateImage(ARTrackedImage data) { var go = ShowObj(data.referenceImage.name, true); if (go != null) { go.transform.position = data.transform.position; go.transform.rotation = data.transform.rotation; ShowText("tracking " + data.referenceImage.name); } }
